brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Two separate pairs of bases (four bases total arranged as two pairs)
requirements.evidence: Four full bases: piece:0,0,0; piece:1,0,0 (top pair) and piece:0,1,0; piece:1,1,0 (bottom pair). Top pair side-by-side, bottom pair side-by-side.

requirements.requirement: The pairs joined to each other only with side connectors (no other joining method between pairs)
requirements.evidence: Pairs linked by connector:0#0,0|0,1 (vertical side-connector-double on left). Additional intra-pair side connectors connector:0#0,0|1,0 and connector:0#0,1|1,1 are also side connectors, so only side connectors are used—no joint bolts, snaps, or other connectors between groups.

finish.summary: Built 2x2 block of four bases as two horizontal pairs (0,0-1,0 and 0,1-1,1) joined between pairs by a side-connector-double on the left edge, with additional side connectors within each pair so all joints are side-connectors only. Mesh clear, no prop warnings.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

events.text: Your bases in pairs, linked only by side connectors — I'll assemble it.

result.note: A side connector joins two bases that stand side by side on the same storey. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

events.text: I see one base on the board — now I'll create your four bases in two linked pairs.
